quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #12
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 35

questions.question: On a highway, it is against the law to drink or carry open alcohol in a motor vehicle. True or false?

options.text: It is illegal to drink or carry open containers of alcohol.
It is legal to drink alcohol if you are not driving.
It is legal to drink alcohol while driving if you are not drunk.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is illegal to drink or carry open containers of alcohol.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drink alcohol while driving. Drivers and passengers cannot have open alcohol containers in a moving vehicle.

questions.question: What does this red and white sign tell you to do?

options.text: Stop and look both ways before going.
Keep your speed and check all directions.

questions.explanation: A yield sign has three sides. It means you must slow down and stop if needed to let other vehicles, cyclists, and pedestrians pass. You do not have the right of way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is unsafe and illegal to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When entering the interstate, you find a gap, match the traffic speed, signal, and then:

options.text: Expect other cars to make room because you have the right of way.
Wait until the lane is completely clear.

questions.explanation: Find a gap, speed up to match traffic, and signal. Then merge into the gap when it is safe. Watch for other vehicles and do not assume other drivers will move for you.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A side road is coming up ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A side road is coming up ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about conditions ahead. This sign tells you a side road will join the road you are on.

questions.question: Which statement is true about taking medicine and driving?

options.text: Most cold medicines can make you sleepy.
Over-the-counter medicine is safe to drive with if you take the right dose.
Any medicine a doctor prescribes is safe to take while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Most cold medicines can make you sleepy.
questions.explanation: Any medicine can affect your driving. Cold and allergy medicine can make you tired. It is your job to know how your medicine affects you before you drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to protect your brakes.

questions.question: What color are regulatory signs?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell you the traffic laws you must follow. They are usually white squares or rectangles with black, red, or green text or symbols.

questions.question: How do you make room for cars entering the freeway?

options.text: Keep your speed and stay in your lane.

questions.explanation: Make room for cars entering the freeway. Move to another lane if you can to create space. If you cannot move, adjust your speed to let them enter safely.

questions.question: What does a five-sided sign mean?

options.text: School zone or school crossing ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing ahead.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign warns drivers of a school zone. It shows where children or pedestrians may cross the street near a school.

questions.question: If a child is about to run into the street, you should:

options.text: Sound a loud blast on your horn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sound a loud blast on your horn.
questions.explanation: Sound a loud blast on your horn when a child or pedestrian is about to enter the street in front of your vehicle.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A yellow triangular sign with black words means no passing zone. It appears on the left side of a two-way, two-lane road where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: One lane is ending soon. Move to the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: One lane is ending soon. Move to the left lane.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that a lane is ending and traffic must move left.

questions.question: When entering traffic after being parked at a curb, you should:

options.text: Drive slower than other traffic for 200 feet.
Wait for a large gap so you can speed up to match traffic.
Wait for the first two vehicles to pass, then drive into the lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for a large gap so you can speed up to match traffic.
questions.explanation: When merging into traffic, wait for a gap large enough for your vehicle to reach the same speed as other traffic.

questions.question: Which of these is a safe driving technique?

options.text: Using high beam lights in fog.
Staring straight ahead at the road.

questions.explanation: Check your rearview mirrors every two to five seconds to stay aware of hazards. Do not stare only at the road ahead. Use low beam headlights in fog, not high beams.

questions.question: If your vehicle begins to skid, you should:
questions.explanation: If your vehicle skids, release the accelerator or brake to help regain control. Steer in the direction of the skid.

questions.question: When double solid yellow lines separate lanes of traffic:

options.text: Passing is allowed from the left.
Passing is allowed from the right.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is not allowed from either direction.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.question: Which of these statements is true about work zones?

options.text: Fines in work zones are the same as regular traffic violations.
You must slow down for the Cone Zone.
Slow down only if workers are present.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must slow down for the Cone Zone.
questions.explanation: Always slow down in work zones to keep drivers, pedestrians, cyclists, and workers safe.

questions.question: This yellow warning sign means:

options.text: You are near a school or school crosswalk.
Slow down and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed near schools to warn drivers to slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the marked line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk or intersection.

questions.question: If you are in an accident, what is one of the first things you must do?

options.text: Call the Secretary of State's Office.

questions.explanation: Do not assume someone is not injured just because they say they are fine. Call for professional help right away.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the right lane is ending. Be ready for traffic to merge.

questions.question: When should you give up your right-of-way?
questions.explanation: Do not assume other drivers will give you the right-of-way. Give up your right-of-way whenever it helps prevent crashes.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows there is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: Water on the road can cause hydroplaning. Your car may hydroplane at speeds as low as:
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when water sits on the road. At speeds up to 35 mph, most tires push water away. At speeds above 35 mph, tires cannot push water away as well. Your tires may lose contact with the road and slide on the water like water skis.

questions.question: You are driving on the freeway behind a large truck. You should drive:

options.text: Close behind the truck in bad weather because the driver can see farther ahead than you.
Farther behind the truck than you would behind a regular car.
No more than one car length behind the truck so the driver can see you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Farther behind the truck than you would behind a regular car.
questions.explanation: If you follow too close behind a truck, the driver cannot see you in the side mirrors. The driver will not know you are there. Tailgating is dangerous because you lose your safety cushion if the truck stops suddenly.

questions.question: You are driving behind a motorcycle and want to pass. You must:

options.text: Stay in the right lane as much as possible because the motorcycle is small.
Honk your horn to make the motorcycle move to the shoulder.
Have your vehicle fully in the left lane before and during the pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Have your vehicle fully in the left lane before and during the pass.
questions.explanation: When passing a motorcycle, give it a full lane. Never share the lane with a motorcycle. Moving back too soon can force the rider to swerve right into traffic or off the road.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down; road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: Hydroplaning happens when tires ride on a thin layer of water instead of the road. To prevent hydroplaning in rain, you should:

options.text: Use cruise control to keep a steady speed.
Move to the shoulder as soon as it starts raining.

questions.explanation: In rain, slow down to reduce the risk of hydroplaning. Driving too fast can cause your tires to ride up on the water and lose contact with the road. This makes it very hard to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What message is on this yellow pennant-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: Yellow pennant-shaped signs warn drivers that they cannot pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers that:

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that the right lane is ending soon and drivers need to move left.

questions.question: To drive safely on an interstate, drivers must:

options.text: Be able to safely drive at higher speeds.

questions.explanation: Interstate driving requires you to stay alert and be able to drive safely at high speeds.

questions.question: If your wheels drop off the road edge, you should:

options.text: Wait until it is safe, then slowly steer back onto the road.
Turn back onto the road immediately.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until it is safe, then slowly steer back onto the road.
questions.explanation: Do not turn sharply back onto the road. Instead, slow down, check for traffic, and slowly steer back onto the road when safe.

questions.question: Orange background signs are:
questions.explanation: Orange signs are only used for construction and maintenance warnings.

questions.question: This round sign warns you that ahead is:
questions.explanation: Round signs mark railroad crossings. They are posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look and listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: A solid yellow line next to a broken yellow line means that vehicles:

options.text: Next to the broken line may pass.
Next to the solid line may pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Next to the broken line may pass.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken yellow line on your side means you may pass.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road. Give them space to merge safely.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road. Give them space to merge safely.
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your mirrors and move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers a clear path.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before you go.
questions.explanation: At a yield sign, slow down and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross in front of you. Stop if necessary before proceeding.

questions.question: Which statement about blind spots is true?

options.text: They disappear if you have one outside mirror on each side.
Large trucks have larger blind spots than most cars.
You can see blind spots by looking in your mirrors.

questions.correctAnswerText: Large trucks have larger blind spots than most cars.
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas you cannot see in your mirrors. Large trucks have much larger blind spots, and other drivers should avoid these areas.
